statements.quote_en: With a view to limiting customer flight from bank deposits, amount limits on conversion from bank accounts appear appropriate.

statements.quote: «uavhengig av driftsopplegg må Norges Bank kunne instruere om alle forhold ved systemet.»
statements.quote_en: “Regardless of the operating arrangement, Norges Bank must be able to direct all aspects of the system.”

statements.quote: Norges Bank må ha absolutt kontroll over kjernen i et DSP-system. Kjernen består i første rekke av pengeutstedelse og -destruksjon, IT-arkitektur for blant annet registeret/kontosystemet og regler/"protokoll" for systemet.
statements.quote_en: Norges Bank must have absolute control over the core of a CBDC system. The core consists primarily of the issuance and destruction of money, the IT architecture for, among other things, the register/account system, and the rules/“protocol” for the system.

statements.quote: Vi vil ikke foreslå endringer i kontanters rettslige status.
statements.quote_en: We will not propose changes to the legal status of cash.

statements.quote: Men vi forutsetter at bestemmelsene om tvungent betalingsmiddel fortsatt skal være deklaratoriske, dvs. at partene i et betalingsoppgjør som utgangspunkt står fritt til å avtale betalingsmiddel.
statements.quote_en: However, we assume that the provisions on legal tender should remain declaratory, i.e. that parties to a payment settlement should in principle remain free to agree on the means of payment.

statements.quote: Hvis DSP skal gis status som tvungent betalingsmiddel, må det lovendringer til, primært en endring av sentralbankloven § 3-5 første ledd.
statements.quote_en: If CBDC is to be granted legal-tender status, legislative changes are required, primarily an amendment to section 3-5 first paragraph of the Central Bank Act.

statements.quote: Hvis DSP skal kunne fungere som tvungent betalingsmiddel, må det være allment og enkelt tilgjengelig, og det må videre være forholdsvis enkelt og billig å bruke.
statements.quote_en: If CBDC is to function as legal tender, it must be generally and easily available, and it must also be relatively easy and inexpensive to use.

statements.quote: Men selve betalingene vil skje uavhengig av bankkonti, og slik sett vil det ikke være noe krav om at betaler og betalingsmottaker har bankkonti.
statements.quote_en: However, the payments themselves will take place independently of bank accounts, and in that sense there will be no requirement for the payer and payee to have bank accounts.

statements.quote: Vi antar at en hensiktsmessig løsning kan være en vekslingsplikt som går begge veier, dvs. at Norges Bank får en plikt til å veksle kontanter til DSP og vice versa.
statements.quote_en: We assume that an appropriate solution may be a two-way conversion obligation, i.e. that Norges Bank is obliged to exchange cash for CBDC and vice versa.

statements.quote: Uavhengig av hvem som skal anses som behandlingsansvarlig, vil prinsippene om innebygd personvern og personvern som standardinnstilling etter GDPR art. 25 være sentrale ved utformingen av DSP, herunder hensynet til dataminimering.
statements.quote_en: Regardless of who is considered the data controller, the principles of data protection by design and by default under GDPR Article 25 will be central to the design of CBDC, including the consideration of data minimisation.

statements.quote: Som det fremgår flere steder i denne rapporten, bør DSP utformes slik at DSP kan benyttes som en plattform for tredjepartstilbydere.
statements.quote_en: As is apparent in several places in this report, CBDC should be designed so that it can be used as a platform for third-party providers.

statements.quote: Mottaker av en DSP-betaling bør ha mulighet til å få tilgang på pengene umiddelbart.
statements.quote_en: The recipient of a CBDC payment should be able to access the money immediately.

statements.quote: DSP-infrastrukturen må legge til rette slik at betalinger kan være umiddelbare.
statements.quote_en: The CBDC infrastructure must facilitate payments being immediate.

statements.quote: I utgangspunktet bør også overføringer mellom DSP og bankinnskudd skje umiddelbart.
statements.quote_en: In principle, transfers between CBDC and bank deposits should also take place immediately.

statements.quote: DSP-arkitekturen må ivareta alle disse sikkerhetselementene.
statements.quote_en: The CBDC architecture must safeguard all these security elements.

statements.quote: Krav til kapasitet og transaksjonsvolum, slik at brukerne får gjennomført de betalingene de ønsker uten at det oppstår ulemper slik som økt tidsbruk.
statements.quote_en: Requirements for capacity and transaction volume, so that users can complete the payments they want without disadvantages such as increased time use.

statements.quote: Krav til tilgjengelighet for personer med funksjonshemming, og samsvar med nasjonale retningslinjer i denne sammenheng.
statements.quote_en: Requirements for accessibility for persons with disabilities, and compliance with national guidelines in this respect.

statements.quote: Tilrettelegging for interoperabilitet og at DSP kan samvirke med andre offentlige og private registre.
statements.quote_en: Facilitation of interoperability and of CBDC being able to interact with other public and private registers.

statements.quote:
Interoperabilitet vil være relevant for DSP i flere dimensjoner:
- interoperabilitet mellom DSP-systemer i ulike land.
statements.quote_en:
Interoperability will be relevant for CBDC in several dimensions:
- interoperability between CBDC systems in different countries.

statements.quote: For å oppfylle krav til tilgjengelighet for personer med funksjonshemminger kan det være hensiktsmessig at DSP er interoperatibelt med løsninger som allerede er utviklet for å oppfylle krav til tilgjengelighet, for eksempel mobiltelefoner og brukergrensesnitt for svaksynte.
statements.quote_en: To meet accessibility requirements for persons with disabilities, it may be appropriate for CBDC to be interoperable with solutions already developed to meet accessibility requirements, such as mobile phones and user interfaces for the visually impaired.

statements.quote: Kravet dreier seg om at systemet kan fungere uavhengig av bankenes betalingssystemer og også fungere for offline-betalinger i en periode.
statements.quote_en: The requirement concerns the system being able to function independently of the banks' payment systems and also function for offline payments for a period.

statements.quote: Det er rimelig å forutsette at i alle fall kjerneinfrastrukturen i et DSP-system må være teknisk uavhengig av andre aktørers løsninger.
statements.quote_en: It is reasonable to assume that at least the core infrastructure in a CBDC system must be technically independent of other actors' solutions.

statements.quote: I et beredskapsperspektiv bør det legges mest vekt på mulighetene for å betale på kritiske områder, slik som dagligvarer, medisiner og drivstoff.
statements.quote_en: From an emergency-preparedness perspective, greatest emphasis should be placed on the ability to pay in critical areas, such as groceries, medicines, and fuel.

statements.quote: For at modulen skal kunne benyttes i en offline-/beredskapssituasjon er det viktig at det er overført midler på forhånd.
statements.quote_en: For the module to be usable in an offline/emergency situation, it is important that funds have been transferred in advance.

statements.quote: Hvis alle kontrolloppgavene skal foretas av tredjeparter, må det teknisk være mulig for tredjeparter å følge transaksjoner på samme måte som med bankinnskudd i dag.
statements.quote_en: If all control tasks are to be performed by third parties, it must be technically possible for third parties to follow transactions in the same way as with bank deposits today.

statements.quote: Fleksibiliteten til å tilpasse et DSP-system til ulike grader av personvern er begrenset av personvernregler som setter minimumskrav til personvernet, og begrensninger som følge av blant annet regelverk skal overvåke og motvirke betalinger knyttet til kriminelle aktiviteter.
statements.quote_en: The flexibility to adapt a CBDC system to different degrees of privacy is limited by privacy rules that set minimum privacy requirements, and by limitations resulting, among other things, from rules intended to monitor and counter payments linked to criminal activities.

statements.quote: Personvernreglene gjennomfører en rekke prinsipper som DSP må følge.
statements.quote_en: Privacy rules implement a number of principles that CBDC must follow.

statements.quote: Krav til kundekontroll vil likevel innebære at det må gjøres koblinger mellom «tokens» og identitet, for eksempel ved on-boarding av nye brukere, store transaksjoner og mistenkelige transaksjoner.
statements.quote_en: Customer-control requirements will nevertheless mean that links must be made between tokens and identity, for example when onboarding new users, for large transactions, and for suspicious transactions.

statements.quote: Fra Norges Bank (2019) følger det at det er ønskelig at DSP kan utgjøre en plattform for tredjepartstilbydere.
statements.quote_en: Norges Bank (2019) states that it is desirable for CBDC to constitute a platform for third-party providers.

statements.quote: Sistnevnte variant vurderes som mer hensiktsmessig fordi full programmeringsfunksjonalitet i DSP-registeret vil kunne gi DSP-registeret funksjoner og roller som ligger utenfor sentralbankens oppgaver, for eksempel tokeniserte verdipapirer og eiendom.
statements.quote_en: The latter variant is considered more appropriate because full programming functionality in the CBDC register could give the register functions and roles that lie outside the central bank's responsibilities, for example tokenised securities and property.

statements.quote: Både dette og ønsket om å kunne påvirke etterspørselen etter DSP av hensyn til finansiell stabilitet (se avsnitt 2.4) tilsier at det må være mulig å sette en rente på DSP som kan variere.
statements.quote_en: Both this and the desire to be able to influence demand for CBDC for reasons of financial stability imply that it must be possible to set a CBDC interest rate that can vary.

statements.quote: Dersom DSP har likhetstrekk med kontanter og primært vil være for betalinger og ikke verdioppbevaring, kan en vurdere å starte med nullrente på DSP, men ha lagt teknisk og avtalemessig til rette for at renten kan variere.
statements.quote_en: If CBDC has similarities to cash and is primarily intended for payments rather than value storage, it may be considered to start with zero interest on CBDC, while having technical and contractual arrangements in place for the interest rate to vary.

statements.quote: Rentebetingelser og kvotesystemer må utformes på en slik måte at gjennomføringen av pengepolitikken ikke forstyrres.
statements.quote_en: Interest-rate terms and quota systems must be designed so that the implementation of monetary policy is not disrupted.

statements.quote: Slik identifisering må avveies mot redusert fleksibilitet med hensyn til personvern og anonyme betalinger.
statements.quote_en: Such identification must be weighed against reduced flexibility regarding privacy and anonymous payments.

statements.quote: Det er ønskelig at DSP-systemet kan gi relevant informasjon i Norges Banks makroøkonomiske overvåking.
statements.quote_en: It is desirable that the CBDC system can provide relevant information for Norges Bank's macroeconomic monitoring.

statements.quote: En forutsetning for å kunne analysere data er at DSP-systemet har en statistikkmodul eller i det minste et verktøy for å hente ut informasjon på egnet form for analyse i andre program.
statements.quote_en: A prerequisite for being able to analyse data is that the CBDC system has a statistics module or at least a tool for extracting information in a form suitable for analysis in other software.

statements.quote: DSP-regelverket inkludere bestemmelser om bruk, rettigheter og sikkerhet for DSP-data.
statements.quote_en: The CBDC rules must include provisions on the use, rights and security of CBDC data.

statements.quote: I forlengelsen av dette må det også være et opplegg for kundenes tilgang til data og for tredjepartsaktørers tilgang til kunders data via API, dersom kunder ønsker dette.
statements.quote_en: In addition, there must be arrangements for customers' access to data and for third parties' access to customers' data via an API, if customers want this.

statements.quote: I en registerbasert løsning vil det ikke være identitet i kjerneregisteret, dette vil eventuelt ligge i et ekstra register med identitet som knyttes til kjerneregisteret.
statements.quote_en: In a register-based solution, there will be no identity in the core register; this would instead be held in an additional identity register linked to the core register.

statements.quote: Det er ønskelig at DSP kan fungere som en nisjeløsning som fyller særskilte betalingsbehov for brukerne.
statements.quote_en: It is desirable that CBDC can function as a niche solution that meets users' particular payment needs.

statements.quote: Det er imidlertid nødvendig at DSP tilrettelegges for bredere bruk allerede fra starten av.
statements.quote_en: However, it is necessary that CBDC be prepared for broader use from the outset.

statements.quote: Noen friksjoner mot bankinnskudd som skal bidra til finansiell stabilitet (for eksempel kvoter for innehav av eller omveksling til DSP) kan forsterke paritetsbrudd mellom DSP og bankinnskudd som har oppstått som følge av stor usikkerhet om den finansielle stillingen til hele banksektoren.
statements.quote_en: Some frictions against bank deposits intended to contribute to financial stability, such as quotas on CBDC holdings or conversion to CBDC, may amplify parity deviations between CBDC and bank deposits arising from major uncertainty about the financial condition of the banking sector as a whole.

statements.quote: Noen friksjoner (for eksempel renter) kan kreve mer identifisering av kunden av rapporteringshensyn, som kan gjøre ulike løsninger som skal gi bedre personvern mindre aktuelle.
statements.quote_en: Some frictions, such as interest rates, may require greater customer identification for reporting purposes, which may make solutions intended to provide better privacy less relevant.

statements.quote: Arbeidsgruppen vurderer det som hensiktsmessig med løsninger som er fleksible for ulike avveininger og er robuste for endrede avveininger i fremtiden.
statements.quote_en: The working group considers solutions that are flexible for different trade-offs and robust to changed trade-offs in the future to be appropriate.

statements.quote:
Norges Banks kjerneinfrastruktur
En rask, sikker og robust plattform som tilbyr relativt enkel betalingsfunksjonalitet
statements.quote_en: Norges Bank's core infrastructure: a fast, secure and robust platform offering relatively simple payment functionality.

statements.quote:
Grensesnitt
Gjør at tredjeparter kan koble seg opp mot kjerneinfrastrukturen. Blokkerer uautorisert tilgang – kun regulert aktører får tilgang
statements.quote_en: Interface: enables third parties to connect to the core infrastructure. Blocks unauthorised access—only regulated actors are granted access.

statements.quote:
Tredjeparter som tilbyr sluttbrukerløsninger
Tredjeparter kan utvikle nye sluttbrukerløsninger, eller eksisterende løsninger kan kobles opp mot DSP-løsningen
statements.quote_en: Third parties offering end-user solutions: third parties can develop new end-user solutions, or existing solutions can be connected to the CBDC solution.

statements.quote:
Brukere
Brukerne av DSP registrerer seg hos tredjeparter for å få tilgang til midler og brukerløsninger
statements.quote_en: Users: CBDC users register with third parties to obtain access to funds and user solutions.

statements.quote: I systemet må det være mulig å overføre midler mellom egne ordinære bankkontoer og egne DSP-kontoer. Dette vil kunne skje enkelt gjennom Norges Banks oppgjørssystem.
statements.quote_en: In the system, it must be possible to transfer funds between one's own ordinary bank accounts and one's own CBDC accounts. This could take place easily through Norges Bank's settlement system.

statements.quote: Det bør imidlertid ikke være mulig å overføre penger mellom ordinære bankkontoer og DSP-kontoer som ikke har samme eier.
statements.quote_en: However, it should not be possible to transfer money between ordinary bank accounts and CBDC accounts that do not have the same owner.

statements.quote: Vi ser for oss at kontosystemet kombineres med en modul for lokal lagring. Hovedformålet med en slik modul er å sikre at det er mulig å gjennomføre betalinger og oppgjør når det ikke er mulig å bruke det sentraliserte kontosystemet, altså i praksis for beredskapsformål.
statements.quote_en: We envisage that the account system will be combined with a module for local storage. The main purpose of such a module is to ensure that payments and settlement can be carried out when it is not possible to use the centralised account system, that is, in practice for contingency purposes.

statements.quote: I modulen for lokal lagring er lagringen basert på sikker hardware, slik som for eksempel smartkort eller Sim-kort / «Secure Element» i en mobiltelefon.
statements.quote_en: In the local-storage module, storage is based on secure hardware, such as smart cards or SIM cards / a Secure Element in a mobile phone.

statements.quote: Betaling i denne lokale modulen skal kunne skje direkte mellom sluttbrukerne uten å autoriseres av tredjepart eller kontosystemet.
statements.quote_en: Payments in this local module must be possible directly between end users without authorisation by a third party or the account system.

statements.quote: En mulighet er at DSP legges som et program på en åpen blokkjede som et program (smartkontrakt28). Vurderingen er at en slik løsning på det nåværende tidspunkt vanskelig lar seg forene med egenskapene DSP må ha.
statements.quote_en: One possibility is for CBDC to be placed as a program on an open blockchain, as a program (smart contract). The assessment is that, at present, such a solution is difficult to reconcile with the properties that CBDC must have.

statements.quote: Dersom DSP skal baseres på en DLT-arkitektur, er det mer aktuelt å benytte en lukket variant av DLT der Norges Bank har full kontroll over reglene for systemet (protokollen).
statements.quote_en: If CBDC is to be based on a DLT architecture, it is more appropriate to use a closed variant of DLT in which Norges Bank has full control over the rules of the system (the protocol).

statements.quote: Dette innebærer at Norges Bank må benytte tekniske løsninger og/eller utvikle regelverk for bruk av DSP eller DSP-representasjoner i eksterne registre.
statements.quote_en: This means that Norges Bank must use technical solutions and/or develop rules for the use of CBDC or CBDC representations in external ledgers.

statements.quote: Dersom det tilbys omfattende programmeringsalternativer på toppen av DSP, som for eksempel legger til rette for tokenisering av aktiva på toppen av DSP-registeret, vil det i praksis kunne gi Norges Bank ansvar utover oppgavene etter sentralbankloven.
statements.quote_en: If extensive programming options are offered on top of CBDC, for example enabling tokenisation of assets on top of the CBDC ledger, this could in practice give Norges Bank responsibilities beyond its tasks under the Central Bank Act.

statements.quote: Det vurderes derfor som hensiktsmessig at DSP tilbyr begrenset programmeringsfunksjonalitet som er tilstrekkelig for interoperabilitet og samvirke med andre registre, slik at «pakkede» varianter av DSP kan benyttes i andre registre med andre og/eller mer omfattende programmeringsalternativer.
statements.quote_en: It is therefore considered appropriate for CBDC to offer limited programming functionality sufficient for interoperability and interaction with other ledgers, so that “wrapped” variants of CBDC can be used in other ledgers with different and/or more extensive programming options.

statements.quote: Kryptografi vil særlig være aktuelt for å kunne fintilpasse DSP til ønsket grad av personvern.
statements.quote_en: Cryptography will be particularly relevant for finely adapting CBDC to the desired degree of privacy.

statements.quote: Ved å disponere over registerenheter gjennom kryptografiske koder istedenfor identifisering, vil brukerne til en viss grad være anonyme.
statements.quote_en: By controlling ledger units through cryptographic codes instead of identification, users will to some extent be anonymous.

statements.quote: Kryptografiske teknikker som «zero-knowledge proof», «ring-signatures» og «stealth-adresses» kan styrke personvernet ytterligere.
statements.quote_en: Cryptographic techniques such as “zero-knowledge proof”, “ring signatures” and “stealth addresses” can further strengthen privacy.

statements.quote: Med dagens teknologi synes en wallet - et brukergrensesnitt/en digital lommebok - på mobiltelefonen å være det mest aktuelle alternativet. Men det bør også være mulig å betale med et kort eller annet fysisk utstyr.
statements.quote_en: With current technology, a wallet—a user interface/digital wallet—on a mobile phone appears to be the most relevant option. However, it should also be possible to pay with a card or other physical equipment.

statements.quote: Brukergrensesnitt for betalinger vil i hovedsak utvikles av tredjepartstilbydere.
statements.quote_en: User interfaces for payments will mainly be developed by third-party providers.

statements.quote: Wallets og andre brukergrensnitt må tilfredsstille krav til tilgjengelighet for særskilte brukergrupper.
statements.quote_en: Wallets and other user interfaces must satisfy accessibility requirements for particular user groups.

statements.quote: For å ivareta egenskapen om at kundekommunikasjon og -kontroll skal utføres av tredjeparter, er det antakeligvis mest hensiktsmessig at Norges Bank finansierer utviklingen av slike eventuelle løsninger som tilbys av tredjeparter fremfor å tilby dette selv.
statements.quote_en: To safeguard the feature that customer communication and control are to be performed by third parties, it is probably most appropriate for Norges Bank to finance the development of any such solutions offered by third parties rather than provide them itself.

statements.quote: En DSP-løsning bør teknisk og regulatorisk legge til rette for at en bruker ikke blir låst inne til et brukergrensesnitt.
statements.quote_en: A CBDC solution should technically and regulatorily facilitate that a user is not locked into one user interface.

statements.quote: Hvis brukeren mister tilgangen til koden eller blir utsatt for ondsinnet programvare, vil brukeren kunne miste eller bli frastjålet midlene sine.
statements.quote_en: If the user loses access to the code or is exposed to malicious software, the user may lose their funds or have them stolen.

statements.quote: En ulempe ved denne løsningen er at brukeren er sårbar for å miste tilgang til DSP ved svikt hos og angrep mot denne aktøren. Brukeren kan ikke enkelt bytte til en annen tilbyder.
statements.quote_en: A disadvantage of this solution is that the user is vulnerable to losing access to CBDC in the event of failure or attacks on this actor. The user cannot easily switch to another provider.

statements.quote: Dersom en slik tredjepartsaktør blir stor, kan slik svikt i tillegg få systemiske konsekvenser siden mange ikke vil få tilgang til sine DSP.
statements.quote_en: If such a third-party actor becomes large, such failure may also have systemic consequences because many people would not have access to their CBDC.

statements.quote: I en kontobasert løsning med mulighet for lokal lagring må en offline-løsning være innebygget.
statements.quote_en: In an account-based solution with the possibility of local storage, an offline solution must be built in.

statements.quote: En offline-løsning må åpne for at det i alle fall midlertidig kan gjennomføres transaksjoner uten kommunikasjon med registeret.
statements.quote_en: An offline solution must allow transactions to be carried out, at least temporarily, without communication with the register.

statements.quote: Dersom for eksempel telekommunikasjonslinjene svikter, vil ikke et alternativt register være en løsning for manglende tilgang til DSP-registeret.
statements.quote_en: If, for example, telecommunications lines fail, an alternative register will not solve the lack of access to the CBDC register.

statements.quote: Ved slike offline-løsninger vil teknologi gjøre det vanskelig for brukeren å teknisk manipulere løsningen for å kunne betale med samme midler flere ganger («double-spending»). Det finnes imidlertid ingen løsninger som kan «garantere» mot slik manipulasjon.
statements.quote_en: With such offline solutions, technology will make it difficult for the user to technically manipulate the solution in order to pay with the same funds more than once (“double spending”). However, there are no solutions that can “guarantee” against such manipulation.

statements.quote: Det vil si at transaksjoner i slike registre ikke vil være umiddelbare og endelige i den forstand at transaksjoner vil bli umiddelbart registrert i DSP-registeret.
statements.quote_en: This means that transactions in such registers will not be immediate and final in the sense that transactions will be immediately recorded in the CBDC register.

statements.quote: I henhold til de nødvendige egenskapene skal kundekommunikasjon og -kontroll foretas av tredjeparter. Dette vil innebære at det i utgangspunktet vil være den enkelte aktørs systemer for kundekontroll («Know Your Customer» - KYC) som vil anvendes for å kontrollere nye brukere i systemet (on-boarding) og AML/ATF (anti-hvitvasking/anti-terrorfinansiering)-kontroll med transaksjoner.
statements.quote_en: According to the necessary characteristics, customer communication and control shall be carried out by third parties. This means that, in principle, each actor's customer-control systems (Know Your Customer, KYC) will be used to control new users in the system (onboarding) and for AML/CTF control of transactions.

statements.quote: En DSP-løsning bør ikke hindre en slik form for effektivisering.
statements.quote_en: A CBDC solution should not prevent such a form of efficiency improvement.

statements.quote: DSPs primære funksjon er å fremme et sikkert og effektivt betalingssystem, og andre funksjoner kan komme i konflikt med dette formålet.
statements.quote_en: The primary function of CBDC is to promote a safe and efficient payment system, and other functions may conflict with this purpose.

statements.quote: Dersom det legges til rette for at det er mulig for ulike myndigheter å overvåke og styre transaksjoner, kan dette gjøre DSP mindre attraktivt for brukerne.
statements.quote_en: If arrangements are made so that different authorities can monitor and control transactions, this may make CBDC less attractive to users.

statements.quote: Det vil også kunne medføre at Norges Bank mister kontroll ved at andre myndigheter vil ønske å påvirke design og funksjon. I tillegg vil slike løsninger kunne innebære at pengene i systemet ikke blir fungible.
statements.quote_en: It could also cause Norges Bank to lose control because other authorities would want to influence the design and function. In addition, such solutions could mean that money in the system is not fungible.

statements.quote: Arbeidet med validering av løsninger i prosjektfase 3 har ikke endret denne vurderingen.
statements.quote_en: The work on validating solutions in project phase 3 has not changed this assessment.

statements.quote: Vurderingen er derfor at Norges Bank gjennom mer begrenset programmeringsfunksjonalitet og standarder bør legge til rette for interoperabilitet med andre registre som tilbyr slik funksjonalitet.
statements.quote_en: The assessment is therefore that Norges Bank should, through more limited programming functionality and standards, facilitate interoperability with other registries that offer such functionality.

statements.quote: Det er derfor nødvendig å benytte en teknisk infrastruktur og et regelverk som gir akseptabelt ansvar og omdømmerisiko.
statements.quote_en: It is therefore necessary to use a technical infrastructure and a regulatory framework that provide an acceptable level of liability and reputational risk.

statements.quote: En registerbasert tokenløsning krever i utgangspunktet kommunikasjon med et register for å validere, prosessere og registrere transaksjoner, og slik kommunikasjon vil i utgangspunktet være nødvendig for at betalinger er endelige.
statements.quote_en: A register-based token solution in principle requires communication with a registry to validate, process and record transactions, and such communication will in principle be necessary for payments to be final.

statements.quote: Løsninger basert på senere konsolidering mot et DSP-register innebærer at betalinger ikke er endelige.
statements.quote_en: Solutions based on later consolidation with a CBDC registry mean that payments are not final.

statements.quote: For eksempel vil større grad av identifisering legge til rette for ulike friksjoner mot bankinnskudd, slik som renter og beløpsgrenser, men kan redusere det opplevde personvernet.
statements.quote_en: For example, a greater degree of identification will facilitate various frictions against bank deposits, such as interest rates and amount limits, but may reduce perceived privacy.

statements.quote: Det vurderes derfor som hensiktsmessig å ikke opprettholde dette skillet i det videre valideringsarbeidet.
statements.quote_en: It is therefore considered appropriate not to maintain this distinction in the further validation work.

statements.quote: På et overordnet nivå har ikke valideringsgruppen gjort noen funn som skulle tilsi at prinsippene for en kontobasert modell ikke er kompatible med egenskapene DSP må ha.
statements.quote_en: At an overall level, the validation group has made no findings that would indicate that the principles of an account-based model are incompatible with the properties a CBDC must have.

statements.quote: En kontobasert modell vil trolig også gi mindre fleksibilitet knyttet til personvern, blant annet gjennom at det er vanskelig(ere) å tilby anonymitet.
statements.quote_en: An account-based model will probably also provide less flexibility regarding privacy, including because it is difficult(er) to offer anonymity.

statements.quote: Det er også usikkerhet knyttet til hvorvidt et kontobasert system er kompatibelt med DLT.
statements.quote_en: There is also uncertainty as to whether an account-based system is compatible with DLT.

statements.quote: På den annen side vil et kontobasert system med en egen modul for lokal lagring trolig være best egnet til umiddelbare og endelige offline-betalinger i en beredskapssituasjon.
statements.quote_en: On the other hand, an account-based system with a separate module for local storage will probably be best suited to immediate and final offline payments in an emergency situation.

statements.quote: Selv om skillet mellom løsninger i BIS (2018) kan være nyttig for eksempel ved analyser av økonomiske virkninger, synes det ikke hensiktsmessig å opprettholde skillet i det videre arbeidet med å validere løsninger mot egenskaper, særlig i teknisk testing.
statements.quote_en: Although the distinction between solutions in BIS (2018) may be useful, for example in analyses of economic effects, it does not seem appropriate to maintain the distinction in the further work of validating solutions against properties, especially in technical testing.

statements.quote: Det er grunn til å anta at noe av innskuddene vil erstattes og at etterspørselen etter innskudd blir mer rentefølsom.
statements.quote_en: There is reason to assume that some deposits will be replaced and that demand for deposits will become more interest-sensitive.

statements.quote: Arbeidsgruppens hovedkonklusjon er at det er mulig å oppnå en tilpasning der virkningen på bankenes finansiering og utlånsrenter blir begrensede.
statements.quote_en: The working group's main conclusion is that it is possible to achieve an adjustment in which the effect on banks' funding and lending rates is limited.

statements.quote: Løp mot bankinnskudd («bank run») kan antas å utløses noe lettere dersom DSP innføres.
statements.quote_en: Runs on bank deposits ('bank runs') may be assumed to be triggered somewhat more easily if a CBDC is introduced.

statements.quote: Man kan derfor komme til å stå overfor en avveining: Liten effekt på bankenes finansiering og utlånsrenten på den ene siden, versus høy risiko på sentralbankens balanse.
statements.quote_en: One may therefore face a trade-off: a small effect on banks' funding and lending rates on the one hand, versus high risk on the central bank's balance sheet.

statements.quote: For å unngå et svært stort volum av DSP har det blitt foreslått at man kan tilby et begrenset volum DSP med for eksempel null rente, men å la DSP utover et gitt volum få lavere rente.
statements.quote_en: To avoid a very large volume of CBDC, it has been proposed that a limited volume of CBDC could be offered with, for example, zero interest, while CBDC above a given volume would receive a lower interest rate.

statements.quote: DSP-renten setter dessuten et gulv for bankenes innskuddsrenter både på transaksjonsinnskudd, og også på øvrige innskudd dersom DSP fungerer som verdioppbevaring.
statements.quote_en: The CBDC interest rate also sets a floor for banks' deposit rates, both on transaction deposits and on other deposits if CBDC functions as a store of value.

statements.quote: I tider med finansiell uro kan det dessuten oppstå løp mot bankene, slik at etterspørselen etter DSP kan bli langt større.
statements.quote_en: In periods of financial turmoil, runs on banks may also arise, so that demand for CBDC may become much greater.

statements.quote: Skulle husholdningene erstatte sedler og mynt med DSP, vil det ikke skje noe på balansen til de private bankene.
statements.quote_en: If households were to replace banknotes and coins with CBDC, nothing would happen to private banks' balance sheets.

statements.quote: Dersom publikum derimot ønsker å ta ut bankinnskudd for å kjøpe DSP, påvirkes både bankenes balanser og sentralbankens balanse.
statements.quote_en: If, on the other hand, the public wishes to withdraw bank deposits to buy CBDC, both banks' balance sheets and the central bank's balance sheet are affected.

statements.quote: Sentralbankens balanse må øke dersom DSP ikke erstatter kontanter eller andre eksisterende krav private ellers har på sentralbanken.
statements.quote_en: The central bank's balance sheet must increase if CBDC does not replace cash or other existing claims that the private sector otherwise has on the central bank.

statements.quote: Høy rente på DSP kan likevel presse ned rentemarginen på gjenstående innskudd.
statements.quote_en: A high interest rate on CBDC may nevertheless put downward pressure on the interest margin on remaining deposits.

statements.quote: Bankene kan som nevnt ikke erstatte innskudd som forsvinner med annen finansiering enn sentralbanklån (eller trekke ned på sentralbankreserver).
statements.quote_en: As mentioned, banks cannot replace deposits that disappear with financing other than central-bank loans (or by drawing down central-bank reserves).

statements.quote: Innskuddene kan blir mer volatile og/eller rentesensitive som følge av innføring av DSP.
statements.quote_en: Deposits may become more volatile and/or interest-sensitive as a result of introducing CBDC.

statements.quote: Dersom innføringen av DSP medfører at noe innskuddsfinansiering erstattes av sentralbanklån og gir høyere finansieringskostnader totalt for det som tidligere bestod av ren innskuddsfinansiering, vil dermed virkningen på utlånsrenten være begrenset til 40 prosent av disse økningene i finansieringskostnader.
statements.quote_en: If the introduction of CBDC means that some deposit funding is replaced by central-bank loans and results in higher total funding costs for what previously consisted of pure deposit funding, the effect on lending rates will therefore be limited to 40 percent of these increases in funding costs.

statements.quote: Noe økning i markedsfinansieringskostnadene kan oppstå som følge av lavere kredittrating dersom en vesentlig del av innskuddene faller bort. Økt markedsfinansiering og høyere markedsfinansieringskostnader kan dra opp bankenes utlånsrenter.
statements.quote_en: Some increase in market-funding costs may arise as a result of lower credit ratings if a significant share of deposits disappears. Increased market funding and higher market-funding costs may raise banks' lending rates.

statements.quote: Innføring av DSP kan lede til løp mot banker. Det innebærer stor etterspørsel etter DSP og at sentralbanken kan måtte stå for en stor del av bankenes finansiering (potensielt tilsvarende hele deres innskuddsfinansiering). Det vil være destabiliserende for det finansielle systemet og øker risikoen på sentralbankens balanse.
statements.quote_en: The introduction of CBDC may lead to runs on banks. This entails high demand for CBDC and that the central bank may have to account for a large share of banks' funding, potentially corresponding to all their deposit funding. This would be destabilising for the financial system and increases risk on the central bank's balance sheet.

statements.quote: Som hovedantakelse vil vi derfor legge til grunn at det er liten fare for løp mot bankenes sikrede innskudd. Det er allikevel sannsynlig at faren for løp mot bankene øker ved innføring av DSP.
statements.quote_en: As a main assumption, we will therefore assume that there is little danger of runs on banks' insured deposits. Nevertheless, it is likely that the danger of runs on banks increases with the introduction of CBDC.

statements.quote: Denne økte faren for løp mot bankene kan tilsi at bankene bør holde høyere likviditetsbuffere enn i dag.
statements.quote_en: This increased danger of runs on banks may indicate that banks should hold higher liquidity buffers than today.

statements.quote: Renten på DSP kan settes vesentlig lavere enn på innskudd ved innføring av en type DSP som kan fungere som verdioppbevaring. Denne mulighet ble fremhevet i fase 1 av DSP-prosjektet.
statements.quote_en: The interest rate on CBDC can be set substantially lower than on deposits when introducing a type of CBDC that can serve as a store of value. This possibility was highlighted in phase 1 of the CBDC project.

statements.quote: Som for bankenes innskudd i Norges Bank kan man ha to renter på DSP, der man får en høyere rente (for eksempel styringsrenten) innenfor en kvote, og en lavere rente på resterende innskudd (tilsvarende reserverenten til bankene i dag). Dette kan bidra til at etterspørselen etter DSP holder seg i et ønsket intervall og at innskyterne har mindre insentiv til å løpe fra innskudd til DSP. Denne muligheten ble drøftet i fase 1 av DSP-prosjektet
statements.quote_en: As for banks' deposits at Norges Bank, CBDC can have two interest rates: a higher rate, for example the policy rate, within a quota, and a lower rate on the remaining deposits, corresponding to the banks' reserve rate today. This can help keep demand for CBDC within a desired range and give depositors less incentive to run from deposits to CBDC. This possibility was discussed in phase 1 of the CBDC project.

statements.quote: Et forslag som ble fremmet i prosjektfase 2, er at krypteringsnøkkelen til en DSP-beholdning kan mistes og at man da vil miste hele beholdningen. Det kan forhindre at publikum ønsker å holde store DSP-beløp.
statements.quote_en: A proposal put forward in project phase 2 is that the encryption key to a CBDC holding can be lost, in which case the entire holding would be lost. This may prevent the public from wishing to hold large CBDC amounts.

statements.quote: Siden forventningen om stenging av veksling mellom DSP og innskudd kan gi insentiver til løp, mens LLR kan begrense disse insentivene, er det mulig at sentralbanken har større fordel av å kommunisere klart at den vil opptre som LLR ved et mulig løp, enn å åpne for muligheten for en bank holiday eller midlertidige kvantumsbegrensninger på DSP.
statements.quote_en: Since expectations that conversion between CBDC and deposits will be closed can create incentives for runs, whereas lender-of-last-resort support can limit these incentives, the central bank may benefit more from clearly communicating that it will act as lender of last resort in a possible run than from opening for a bank holiday or temporary quantitative restrictions on CBDC.

statements.quote: Hvis DSP erstatter innskudd og fungerer godt som betalingsmiddel, kan etterspørselen etter bankinnskudd bli lavere og mer rentesensitiv.
statements.quote_en: If CBDC replaces deposits and functions well as a means of payment, demand for bank deposits may become lower and more interest-rate sensitive.

statements.quote: Innføring av DSP kan basert på dette sannsynligvis gjennomføres uten vesentlig virkning på tilgangen til kreditt i norsk økonomi, og sentralbanken vil ha stor innflytelse på denne virkningen gjennom hvordan reserver tilføres ved innføring av DSP og gjennom hvilken rente som settes på DSP.
statements.quote_en: Based on this, the introduction of CBDC can probably be implemented without a significant effect on access to credit in the Norwegian economy, and the central bank will have substantial influence on this effect through how reserves are supplied upon the introduction of CBDC and through the interest rate set on CBDC.

statements.quote: Virkningene på sentralbankens balanse og risiko kan imidlertid bli betydelig, særlig hvis det skulle oppstå et løp mot bankene.
statements.quote_en: However, the effects on the central bank's balance sheet and risk may be substantial, especially if a run on banks should occur.

statements.quote: Fordring på Norges Bank
statements.quote_en: A claim on Norges Bank

statements.quote: Par verdi mot kontanter og bankinnskudd
statements.quote_en: Par value against cash and bank deposits

statements.quote: Kunderettet fokus
statements.quote_en: Customer-oriented focus

statements.quote: Tilstrekkelig friksjon mot bankpenger
statements.quote_en: Sufficient friction against bank money

statements.quote: Kontrollert av Norges Bank
statements.quote_en: Controlled by Norges Bank

statements.quote: Kan fungere som tvungent betalingsmiddel
statements.quote_en: Can function as legal tender

statements.quote: Betalinger umiddelbare og endelige
statements.quote_en: Payments immediate and final

statements.quote: at ønske om offline-betalinger inngår i krav til teknisk uavhengighet
statements.quote_en: that the desire for offline payments is included in the requirement for technical independence

statements.quote: Samsvar med gode IT-arkitekturprinsipper
statements.quote_en: Compliance with sound IT architecture principles

statements.quote: Tilfredsstiller krav til teknisk uavhengighet og mulighet for betaling offline
statements.quote_en: Meets requirements for technical independence and the possibility of offline payment

statements.quote: Kundekommunikasjon og -kontroll foretas av tredjeparter
statements.quote_en: Customer communication and control are carried out by third parties

statements.quote: Fleksibilitet for ulike personvernløsninger
statements.quote_en: Flexibility for different privacy solutions

statements.quote: Teste hvordan ulike løsninger kan gi mer eller mindre anonyme betalinger innenfor regulatoriske krav.
statements.quote_en: Test how different solutions can provide more or less anonymous payments within regulatory requirements.

statements.quote: Plattform for tredjepartstilbydere
statements.quote_en: Platform for third-party providers

statements.quote: Ivareta gjennomslaget av pengepolitikken
statements.quote_en: Safeguard the effectiveness of monetary policy

statements.quote: DLT-kompatibelt
statements.quote_en: DLT-compatible

Technical solutions recommended in Norges Bank (2019):
A CBDC in the form of register-based token money
The CBDC is linked to a register and is accessed via cryptographic codes not associated with an identity.

Technical solutions recommended in Norges Bank (2019):
Closed account solution offering the option of local storage
This solution is combined with a functionality to “load” funds onto a physical device (eg a card or mobile phone) for offline use.
introducing retail CBDC is not a very urgent matter.
The testing was mainly conducted in a test network/prototype and blockchain technology (private/closed Ethereum network).
The prototype is a simple core infrastructure for CBDC: a registry/database and functionality for issuing, distributing, confiscation and settlement of CBDC.
An important finding is that the characteristics from Norges Bank (2021) so far appear to be achievable with the technology employed in the testing.
Thus, to exploit the advantages and disadvantages inherent in different registry solutions, it may be appropriate for CBDC to use several registries linked together through bridges.

In general, our assessment, based on the testing work and information obtained from suppliers of CBDC solutions to other countries, is that there are currently no available fully developed solutions that can satisfactorily fulfil the requirements and necessary characteristics of a Norwegian CBDC.
However, we believe it is premature to draw a conclusion about which technological solution for the core infrastructure of a potential Norwegian CBDC is most appropriate.

The working group is of the opinion that it is probably not appropriate for Norges Bank itself to develop and maintain the core infrastructure, given the resources this requires and the role Norges Bank must then take on.
We will be completely dependent on banks and other payment service providers facilitating payment services for end customers based on CBDC as a source of money.

High demand for CBDC can affect banks' balance sheets, funding costs and the monetary and credit-generating process, as well as the central bank's balance sheet and risk, and the implementation of liquidity and monetary policy.
Reducing financial challenges implies that CBDC should be designed to enable the management of demand.
This can be done via quantitative restrictions (quotas) or through a pricing mechanism (interest rate).
Quotas, in the form of a limit on how much CBDC each person can hold, provide a secure limit on the amount of CBDC outstanding.
If the public’s CBDC storage/holdings reach a high level in a new equilibrium, the central bank's balance sheet and footprint in the financial system will increase.
CBDC should not primarily be seen as a monetary policy instrument

Liquidity management is likely to be more unpredictable, but is nevertheless considered manageable, provided that CBDC is designed with a view to substantially reducing the financial disadvantages mentioned above.
The introduction of CBDC can reduce monetary policy leeway by diminishing the pass-through from the policy rate to bank rates and by raising the effective lower bound for the policy interest rate.

CBDC should be designed in a way that enables the management of demand. This can be achieved by means of individual quotas or by setting interest rates on CBDC. When using interest rates, the introduction of a two-stage system should be considered.

The issuance of CBDC will require legislative amendments to Section 3-4 of the Norges Bank Act on the issuance of cash as means of payment, including potential legal basis for regulating interest rates on CBDC.
If CBDC is also to be granted legal tender status, this must be specified in Section 3-5 of the Norges Bank Act on legal tender.
Norges Bank's responsibility for issuing CBDC should also be set out in Section 1-3 of the Norges Bank Act relating to central banking operations.
Responsibility for customer due diligence under Section 10 (1) (a) of the Anti-Money Laundering Act will, as is the case today, rest with the banks.

Both in Norges Bank's project and internationally, particular attention is placed on a solution where CBDC are issued and distributed on blockchain-based solutions, i.e. solutions that are wholly or partly based on blockchain technology.
Norges Bank should probably not develop infrastructure in-house.

Trends in cash use and innovation in money present an opportunity for the Reserve Bank to consider broadening central bank money to include a widely available digital form, and so continue to meet the needs of New Zealanders.
The Reserve Bank’s initial CBDC considerations are focused on the public policy case for, or against, a CBDC that would be available to all individuals, communities and businesses.
We refer to this as a ‘general-purpose’ CBDC, which we will shorten to CBDC in this paper.

The Reserve Bank’s overall belief is that a CBDC would be a useful development for central bank money, because it would both support the value anchor role of central bank money, and support the ability of central bank money to act as a fair and equal way to pay and save.

Providing individuals and businesses with the option of converting privately issued money into a digital form of central bank money (ensuring the long-term convertibility of private money into central bank money).
Directly providing a basic form of paying and saving to all at a low cost, and acting as a gateway to the formal financial sector.
As with other forms of digital money, a CBDC must be operationally resilient to outages and cyber security risks
To be clear, the Reserve Bank is not considering replacing cash with a CBDC.

A CBDC is not intended to replace these benefits; instead, we are considering whether a CBDC is an opportunity to provide these (and other) benefits digitally. This would provide New Zealanders with a choice of central bank money in physical and digital forms.
this issues paper focuses on a CBDC that would be issued to any individual or business that wants to use it.
The Reserve Bank’s intention is to let a policy discussion inform the technological design of a CDBC rather than the other way around.
A CBDC would provide individuals with freedom and autonomy in saving and paying, primarily by giving them greater choice.

A CBDC cannot be completely anonymous, as in theory all digital transactions would leave a record on either a central ledger or a distributed ledger (due to the need to avoid the double-spend problem).
A CBDC offers an opportunity to design a form of money that balances these interests.
A New Zealand CBDC would allow the Reserve Bank to participate in global cross-border payment initiatives that involve connecting multiple CBDC systems together (referred to as CBDC bridges).

The Reserve Bank has high requirements for the reliability, scalability, throughput and resilience of its existing systemically important payments and settlement systems, and these would also apply to a CBDC.
As a form of digital currency, a CBDC should not be able to be ‘double-spent’.
the distribution of a CBDC would need to comply with AML/CFT requirements as well as financial market infrastructure and consumer protection regulations.
Therefore the CBDC might compete for bank funding in the form of deposits in transaction accounts at both household and wholesale levels.
if demand for a CBDC were high, banks might face runs on their transaction accounts for CBDC.

a CBDC may increase the run risk if it is a) easier and faster to obtain than other safe bonds and assets, and b) there are no costs for, or limits to, holding large sums of CBDC established in the CBDC’s design and operational rules.

If banks lost a large portion of their funding to a CBDC they would need to increase their funding through more expensive means (such as offshore wholesale markets or by increasing remuneration on transaction accounts).
Banks might also respond to lost funding by reducing credit or increasing the price of lending.
Given the identified range of risks to the banking system, the Reserve Bank would need to consider how it would manage the issuance of a CBDC and ensure an orderly and non-destabilising introduction.

As such, there would be an impact on bank funding, possibly a significant one, if there were a wholesale run to a CBDC. This impact would need to feature heavily in the design and calibration of a CBDC.
A CBDC that is uniform would be exchanged 1:1 with cash and support the NZD as our single unit of account.
A CBDC that is made available to all households and businesses would:  Provide access to the benefits of central bank money – as a stable value anchor and lowest-risk form of money – to all.

A CBDC should facilitate autonomy and privacy in paying and saving, provide a personal back-up form of payment (including offline functionality to the extent possible) and enable peer-to-peer payments.

A CBDC should facilitate autonomy and privacy in paying and saving, provide a personal back-up form of payment (including offline functionality to the extent possible) and enable peer-to-peer payments.
Meet evolving needs and maintain the transactional relevance of central bank money over time, including by supporting electronic peer-to-peer payments and near or instant settlement.
Drive innovation and cost efficiency for end users, including through competition and open access.
Be interoperable with other payments services.
Support cross-border payments and be able to support low-cost remittances.

The implementation of a CBDC could have potentially very large impacts on banking sector funding and on the Reserve Bank’s balance sheet. This could be destabilising for the financial system if not mitigated or managed appropriately.
A CBDC should be issued and governed by the Reserve Bank in a manner that avoids unnecessary disruption to the cash system, wider financial system and monetary policy settings.
Be unquestionably operationally resilient – that is, have a similarly low tolerance for system outages and down-times as existing systemically important payment infrastructure.
Not be able to be ‘double-spent’ or fraudulently spent, similarly to the expectations of banknotes and coins and of transaction accounts.
Provide near-instant and legally final settlement.
A CBDC should be exchanged 1:1 with cash and support the NZD as our single unit of account.
A CBDC should provide low-cost, basic saving and payments to all households, including those that are financially and digitally excluded.
A CBDC should facilitate autonomy and privacy in paying and saving, provide a personal back-up form of payment, and enable peer-to-peer payments.
A CBDC should facilitate autonomy and privacy in paying and saving, provide a personal back-up form of payment, and enable peer-to-peer payments.
A CBDC should be modern, be interoperable and drive innovation in New Zealand’s money and payments ecosystem, and provide a potential new monetary policy tool.
A CBDC should be unquestionably operationally resilient, avoid double-spending, provide near-instant final settlement and comply with all regulations.
A CBDC should be issued and governed by the Reserve Bank in a manner that avoids unnecessary disruption to the cash system, the wider financial system and monetary policy settings.
The choice to issue a CBDC as account based or token based would depend on which design is considered the best to meet the CBDC objectives.

Scenarios two and three highlight that a run on commercial bank transaction accounts to a CBDC could also increase the Reserve Bank’s balance sheet if the commercial banks used liquid and non-liquid assets to swap for CBDC.

They also show that if a CBDC were to be issued in exchange for other non-liquid assets then a CBDC would provide some monetary stimulus, i.e. it could be issued as a monetary policy tool or its issuance might conflict with monetary policy settings if that impact were not intended.
RBNZ’s initial preference was for a two-tiered model for the distribution of CBDC, using financial intermediaries to promote market-led innovation.

However, in order to achieve its objectives of wide adoption and inclusion, there is the option to retain the capability for the public sector to distribute CBDC directly, possibly through another government agency or through the development of a new intermediary specifically responsible for CBDC distribution, in response to special circumstances.
The current preference seeks to ensure there is a role for both the public and private sector.
RBNZ’s initial preference is for CBDC users to have the ability to transfer between Fiat to CBDC, make payments and manage their CBDC easily.
RBNZ’s preference is for- multiple wallet/access providers per user.
Multiple wallets per user will support competition and innovation within the market and ensure choice for the user.
In order to support innovation and competition, and ensure choice and flexibility for the end user, a CBDC user can own multi-layered wallets.
RBNZ’s initial preference is for users to have the choice for their CBDC wallets collectively accessed and managed, for example, as part of a household/community, joint ownership and businesses.
RBNZ’s initial preference is for all customer onboarding and lifecycle management (including holding and managing customer KYC information) to be the responsibility of the market, not RBNZ.
RBNZ’s initial preference is interoperability with existing payments systems.
CBDC settlement is, by its very nature, final and irrevocable.

Similar to real time payment systems, tools should be employed to help and assist the user in not making errors, but if one occurs, then providing a customer service to assist users who have problems recovering their funds.
Refunds may be facilitated and at the discretion of the intermediaries
Offline capability will be an important feature of a NZ CBDC, as users will be able to spend/transfer/ receive CBDC without access to the internet or cellular data.
Enduring offline is considered as a desirable end-state, subject to an understanding and management of risk, and the capabilities required.

Programmable payments, the ability to build CBDC with tools such as smart contracts,are a core component of CBDC's ability to unlock new and future value for New Zealanders and will be a foundational piece of the CBDC.
Programmable money, a feature of CBDC to enable conditional use, is largely regarded as likely to destroy trust, and as such is not a preference for RBNZ.
Users should own their data and start opted out, with clear opt-in options supported by a consent framework similar to the future NZ Consumer Data Right framework.
Users will be able to spend/transfer/receive CBDC using a payment method at the point of interaction that meets their needs
RBNZ’s initial preference is to ensure that there is the right level of data control whilst not inhibiting commercial innovation.

RBNZ’s initial preference is that the CBDC system will require the least amount of user data possible in order for it to operate as there is the potential to endanger privacy with more user information gathered than is necessary.
A standalone CBDC ecosystem may exclude heavy cash users, so RBNZ’s initial preference is that the CBDC will be interoperable with cash to ensure wide adoption and inclusion.
RBNZ’s initial preference is for CBDC users to be able to connect their CBDC wallets to other existing non-payments systems, e.g., Digital ID systems
RBNZ’s initial preference is for a CBDC system to be developed with the highest possible levels of inclusion to meet the needs of collective owners currently not being met with existing solutions.
This can be done by creating wallets in a hierarchy with multiple owners and by creating and using a management and control hierarchy.
RBNZ’s initial preference is for CBDC users to use proxy identities to protect their privacy in the system.

The issuance of a CBDC is not intended to compete with existing digital payment services, but to expand access to payment services by unbanked people (and other segments of the population who only pay by cash).
Instantaneous and final payments, at low or no cost, and geared to small-ticket transactions.
Universally accessible, easy to use, and able to operate on- and offline.
Multiple use cases, allowing person-to-person (P2P), person-to-business (P2B), and government-to-person (G2P) payments, and vice versa.
Interoperability with bank accounts, e-money accounts, and other payment options.
Application of limits on balances and transaction values.
However, in no case, the CBDC adoption would imply stopping the issuance of physical money.
The public would have at its disposal the two forms of money issued by the central bank, i.e., a CBDC would complement the means of payment that the central bank makes available to the public.
The CBDC adoption would not require changes to the Central Bank Act.

it would be necessary to align BCRP norms with regulations on anti-money laundering/combating the financing of terrorism (AML/CFT), data privacy and protection, KYC requirements, and digital identification, among others.
financial disintermediation (i.e., if people prefer a CBDC over bank deposits), risk that is low as long as the design of CBDC considers similar features as cash and value limits
digital runs (as a CBDC may facilitate cash withdrawals and bank transfers during economic crises), which could be also mitigated with an adequate design of CBDC
reputational risks to the central bank in case the operational and cybersecurity risks involved in the issuance of a CBDC materialize.
If it is decided that the issuance of a CBDC is desirable, the process of its introduction and scalability must be gradual, evaluating its benefits and potential costs or risks at each stage.

It should be initially centered on unbanked people in large cities, based on mobile phones, geared to all gender and age groups, based on an intuitive and friendly interface, and available at low or no cost.
Consumer experience and trust are key to CBDC success.
The CBDC issuance is not intended to compete with existing digital payment services, but to expand unbanked people’s access to payment services.

The CBDC adoption must be gradual, assessing changes in the legal and regulatory framework, as well as benefits and potential costs and risks, at every stage.
Adoption should be initially centered in large cities, based on penetration of mobile phones, and geared towards all gender and age groups.

A CBDC operating on a public retail payment platform would allow all retail payment service providers would be interconnected (closed payment schemes, financial institutions including those not connected to the ACH, e-money issuers, and payment service providers).
In this scheme, transfers could be made from CDBC wallets to bank and e-money accounts, and vice versa, under an interoperable framework.
A CBDC would complement rather than replace existing means of payment.

Additionally, a CBDC would offer the possibility of making digital payments without the need to open a bank account or have an internet connection (offline solution); which is crucial for the adoption of digital payments among the unbanked population far from the main cities.

Contribute to promoting the introduction of programmable payments, which have the potential to personalize the use of money, which would allow conditional transfers, among others, to be able to be used on purchases for a pre-selected set of goods and services, increasing the efficiency of this type of government policies.

If a CBDC pays interest rates, it will compete directly with bank deposits, so part of the deposits could move towards CBDC accounts, affecting the ability of banks to intermediate, with the consequent potential effects of a lower supply of credit and higher interest rates.
In this context, if a systemic problem arises, a CBDC may be a destination for funds leaving from troubled banks, whenever no amount limits are established for their use.
A CBDC could face similar risks, which leads to stronger cyber risk mitigation mechanisms at the central bank and at entities distributing a CBDC.

the dependency of the design and implementation of the CBDC on a technology provider requires creating capabilities so that the team that manages the infrastructure that allows a CBDC to circulate must have the flexibility to meet urgent needs for modifications, updates, and improvements. without depending on a particular technology provider.
For this reason, the technological and communications equipment, and the design of a CBDC must also incorporate the necessary elements to manage these risks effectively.
Although according to the analysis carried out by the Legal Department of the BCRP, the introduction of a CBDC would not imply changes to the Central Bank Act
Therefore, the BCRP is allowed to issue banknotes and coins both in physical and immaterial form, including a CBDC.
In conclusion, no legal amendments to the Central Bank Law would be required to allow CBDC issuance.
In line with the project of a CBDC, its design, and implementation should be focused on granting access to the unbanked population to digital payments.
Consequently, the issuance of a CBDC is not intended to replace the use of other digital means of payment used by the financially included population.

The introduction of a CBDC should contribute to having an ecosystem involving all agents in the payments chain: customers, merchants, wholesale goods distributors, government, financial institutions, and payment service providers.
By offering a payment instrument that is accepted in the same places that cash is accepted, a CBDC can help keep money flows received in money transfers primarily in the financial system.
A CBDC would be accepted in the government’s payment platform, so the unbanked would significantly reduce the costs and risks mentioned above.
At the first stage of CBDC implementation, P2P and P2B payments should be prioritized.
Convenient Easy to use; fast and simple digital onboarding process.

Anonymity CBDC anonymity is attractive to users operating in a cash ecosystem.
a. Wide availability, both on smartphones and regular phones, allows using the CBDC safely and efficiently, with an ample cash-in/cash-out network, to facilitate deposits into wallets.
Fees should be zero and the business models should seek to monetize in other payment flows or value-added services.
b. Full convertibility with the local currency, e.g., PEN 1,000 in private bank deposits would be equivalent to PEN 1,000 in CBDC.

c. A feature for sending payment reminders (e.g., in the case of persons who rent out property), keeping track of payments, and scheduling recurring payments to the same account or person via a real-time mobile solution.
d. Available for offline payments, either through devices embedded in cell phones or stand-alone devices that may be used offline (as Internet access is uneven across the country).
e. A CBDC would provide a simple way to pay salaries into workers’ wallets, thereby reducing costs and risks to both firms and workers.
g. Connection to government payment platforms like Pagalo.pe to avoid having to go to bank agencies.

The intermediated model allows the BCRP to maintain a central ledger of transactions and keep control of payment systems, in line with its supervisory role and its mandate to preserve financial stability.
Citizens would also be provided with any digital wallet to use CBDC, which allows storing digital tokens to make (and receive) payments without necessarily holding a bank account.

It should be possible to carry out payments and transactions even in places with no Internet connection (and in natural disaster scenarios where telecommunications are likely to collapse).

The Palau Stablecoin (PSC) is a digital asset fixed in value to the U.S. Dollar.
users will hold their PSC using a digital wallet.

No. Cash (the US Dollar) will still be used in the Republic of Palau.

The Palau Stablecoin is sponsored and managed by the Palau Ministry of Finance, not a commercial vendor.
There will be no charges with PSU.
There is also more privacy protection for transactions using PSU, as third parties can’t access your transactions.
The Palau Stablecoin is built with Ripple’s technology which doesn’t involve cryptocurrency mining and is therefore energy efficient.

No bank account is necessary for citizens to use the Palau stablecoin.
With a Stablecoin, money transfer can happen without the sender and the recipient being in the same physical location.

El Banco Central del Paraguay se compromete a seguir proporcionando efectivo mientras haya demanda pública.
statements.quote_en: The Central Bank of Paraguay commits to continue providing cash as long as there is public demand.

statements.quote: es de relevante preponderancia, que el Banco Central del Paraguay establezca un Grupo de Trabajo, con el fin de monitorear permanentemente las tendencias de innovación de CBDC, actualmente en curso, y debatidas por los bancos centrales de la región y de todo el mundo.
statements.quote_en: it is highly important that the Central Bank of Paraguay establish a Working Group in order to permanently monitor CBDC innovation trends currently underway and debated by central banks in the region and around the world.

statements.quote: Цифровой рубль будет эмитироваться Банком России
statements.quote_en: The digital ruble will be issued by the Bank of Russia.

statements.quote: он станет третьей формой российской национальной валюты и будет использоваться наравне с наличными и безналичными рублями.
statements.quote_en: It will become the third form of the Russian national currency and will be used alongside cash and non-cash rubles.

statements.quote: Цифровой рубль позволит гражданам и бизнесу иметь доступ к своему цифровому кошельку через любую финансовую организацию, клиентами которой они являются.
statements.quote_en: The digital ruble will allow citizens and businesses to access their digital wallet through any financial institution of which they are customers.

statements.quote: Также цифровой рубль обеспечит расчеты без доступа к сети Интернет (офлайн-режим).
statements.quote_en: The digital ruble will also enable payments without access to the Internet (offline mode).

statements.quote: Клиент может получить доступ к своему кошельку на платформе цифрового рубля через инфраструктуру любой финансовой организации, в которой у него открыт счет.
statements.quote_en: A client can access their wallet on the digital-ruble platform through the infrastructure of any financial institution where they have an account.

statements.quote: Операции с цифровым рублем будут тарифицироваться по единым правилам.
statements.quote_en: Digital-ruble transactions will be priced according to uniform rules.

statements.quote: Повышение доступности финансовых услуг на отдаленных и малонаселенных территориях за счет наличия возможности расчетов между физическими лицами и оплаты товаров и услуг без доступа к сети Интернет (офлайн-режим).
statements.quote_en: Greater access to financial services in remote and sparsely populated areas through the ability to make person-to-person payments and pay for goods and services without Internet access (offline mode).

statements.quote: Цифровой рубль является обязательством Банка России.
statements.quote_en: The digital ruble is a liability of the Bank of Russia.

statements.quote: Повышение уровня безопасности за счет наличия уникальных номеров цифровых рублей, позволяющих отследить их движение и упростить восстановление нарушенных прав владельца в случае их утраты или хищения.
statements.quote_en: A higher level of security through unique digital-ruble numbers, which make it possible to track their movement and simplify restoration of the owner's violated rights in the event of loss or theft.

statements.quote: Применение технологии распределенных реестров позволит участникам рынка создавать и предлагать клиентам новые технологичные сервисы (смарт-контракты, маркирование платежей).
statements.quote_en: The use of distributed-ledger technology will enable market participants to create and offer customers new technological services (smart contracts, payment marking).

statements.quote: Платформа цифрового рубля обеспечит гарантированную адресную доставку целевых выплат гражданам и бизнесу.
statements.quote_en: The digital-ruble platform will ensure guaranteed targeted delivery of earmarked payments to citizens and businesses.

statements.quote: Применение смарт-контрактов позволит автоматизировать и значительно упростить процессы администрирования бюджетных средств, повысить их эффективность и минимизировать операционные риски.
statements.quote_en: The use of smart contracts will automate and substantially simplify budget-funds administration processes, improve their efficiency, and minimize operational risks.

statements.quote: Представленная далее концепция реализации сформирована исходя из выбора двухуровневой розничной модели цифрового рубля (модель D) как целевой.
statements.quote_en: The implementation concept presented below was developed on the basis of selecting the two-tier retail digital-ruble model (Model D) as the target model.

statements.quote: Модель D предполагает следующее: • Банк России открывает кошельки финансовым организациям и Федеральному казначейству;
statements.quote_en: Model D provides for the following: the Bank of Russia opens wallets for financial institutions and the Federal Treasury.

statements.quote: Модель D предполагает следующее: • финансовые организации открывают кошельки клиентам на платформе цифрового рубля и осуществляют по ним расчеты.
statements.quote_en: Model D provides for the following: financial institutions open wallets for clients on the digital-ruble platform and carry out settlements through them.

statements.quote: Цифровые рубли представляют собой уникальные цифровые коды (токены), находящиеся в цифровых кошельках клиентов на платформе цифрового рубля.
statements.quote_en: Digital rubles are unique digital codes (tokens) held in customers' digital wallets on the digital-ruble platform.

statements.quote: Эмитентом цифрового рубля является Банк России.
statements.quote_en: The Bank of Russia is the issuer of the digital ruble.

statements.quote: Цифровой рубль – обязательство Банка России.
statements.quote_en: The digital ruble is a liability of the Bank of Russia.

statements.quote: Зачисление цифрового рубля осуществляется в результате соответствующего списания безналичных средств в соотношении 1:1.
statements.quote_en: Digital rubles are credited as a result of a corresponding debit of non-cash funds at a 1:1 ratio.

statements.quote: Банк России открывает кошельки финансовым организациям и Федеральному казначейству, а финансовые организации открывают кошельки клиентам на платформе цифрового рубля.
statements.quote_en: The Bank of Russia opens wallets for financial institutions and the Federal Treasury, while financial institutions open customer wallets on the digital-ruble platform.

statements.quote: Клиенту открывается только один кошелек в цифровых рублях.
statements.quote_en: A customer is opened only one digital-ruble wallet.

statements.quote: Кошельки клиентов в цифровых рублях размещаются на платформе цифрового рубля и не отражаются на балансе финансовых организаций.
statements.quote_en: Customers' digital-ruble wallets are located on the digital-ruble platform and are not reflected on financial institutions' balance sheets.

statements.quote: На размещенные в кошельках цифровые рубли не начисляется процентный доход на остаток.
statements.quote_en: No interest income is accrued on digital-ruble balances held in wallets.

statements.quote: При банкротстве финансовых организаций средства на кошельке доступны клиенту через любую другую финансовую организацию, где он обслуживается.
statements.quote_en: If a financial institution becomes bankrupt, funds in the wallet remain available to the customer through any other financial institution that serves them.

statements.quote: В целях безопасности проводимых клиентом операций Банк России планирует разработать программный модуль, встраиваемый в мобильное приложение финансовых организаций и обеспечивающий взаимодействие платформы цифрового рубля с клиентом для подтверждения выполнения действий при открытии и пополнении кошелька, переводе средств.
statements.quote_en: To ensure the security of customer transactions, the Bank of Russia plans to develop a software module embedded in financial institutions' mobile applications, enabling interaction between the digital-ruble platform and the customer to confirm actions when opening and funding a wallet and transferring funds.

statements.quote: Данный механизм гарантирует клиенту проведение операций с цифровым рублем только при наличии подтверждения с его стороны.
statements.quote_en: This mechanism guarantees that the customer can conduct digital-ruble transactions only with their confirmation.

statements.quote: Также предполагается, что с использованием цифрового рубля клиентам будет обеспечен сервис по осуществлению бесшовных платежей с переводом из цифровых рублей в безналичные и наличные, а также из наличных и безналичных рублей в цифровые.
statements.quote_en: It is also envisaged that customers will be provided with a service for seamless payments, converting digital rubles into non-cash and cash funds and converting cash and non-cash rubles into digital rubles.

statements.quote: Модель D представляет собой двухуровневую розничную модель.
statements.quote_en: Model D is a two-tier retail model.

statements.quote: Оператор платформы (Банк России): создает, сопровождает и развивает платформу цифрового рубля.
statements.quote_en: The platform operator (the Bank of Russia) creates, maintains, and develops the digital-ruble platform.

statements.quote: Оператор платформы (Банк России): подключает финансовые организации и Федеральное казначейство к платформе цифрового рубля.
statements.quote_en: The platform operator (the Bank of Russia) connects financial institutions and the Federal Treasury to the digital-ruble platform.

statements.quote: Оператор платформы (Банк России): определяет правила осуществления операций на платформе цифрового рубля; создает и распространяет стандарты для работы с платформой цифрового рубля.
statements.quote_en: The platform operator (the Bank of Russia) determines rules for operations on the digital-ruble platform and creates and distributes standards for working with the platform.

statements.quote: Оператор платформы (Банк России): определяет политику обеспечения информационной безопасности и киберустойчивости платформы цифрового рубля.
statements.quote_en: The platform operator (the Bank of Russia) determines the policy for ensuring information security and cyber resilience of the digital-ruble platform.

statements.quote: Эмитент (Банк России): проводит эмиссию цифровых рублей, обладает собственным эмиссионным онлайн-кошельком.
statements.quote_en: The issuer (the Bank of Russia) issues digital rubles and has its own online issuance wallet.

statements.quote: Финансовая организация: осуществляет открытие и пополнение кошельков клиентам на платформе цифрового рубля.
statements.quote_en: A financial institution opens and funds customer wallets on the digital-ruble platform.
